name: report-to-principal
description: Record something the principal should hear about in their next digest: an action you took on their behalf, a decision you made, or how you read an ambiguous instruction. Use urgency 'now' only when you have also pinged them directly. Does not message the principal.

inputs.summary: string (one or two sentences for the principal, at most 500 characters)
inputs.link: string? (a link to the thread or task, if there is one)
